title.en: Fable 17 — The Dog and His Reflection

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A dog took a bone and walked home.
On the way he crossed a bridge.

sentences.ar: הוא הסתכל במים וראה כלב אחר.
sentences.en: He looked in the water and saw another dog.

sentences.ar: לכלב הזה הייתה עצם גדולה יותר.
sentences.en: That dog had a bigger bone.

sentences.ar: הוא פתח את הפה ונבח עליו.
sentences.en: He opened his mouth and barked at him.
The bone fell into the water and disappeared.

sentences.ar: מי שרודף אחרי צל מאבד את היש.
sentences.en: Whoever chases a shadow loses what is there.
